payload.title: Newsroom site switcher and CLI site choice write the TenantSelection and re-issue tokens
payload.description: Outcome: A person picks a site in the newsroom (and in the CLI's signed-in lane) and the session acts for it: the choice is written to the person's TenantSelection row (papyrus_content.tenant_records.tenant_selection_record; id = their Cognito sub) and the tokens are re-issued so the pre-token trigger (PPY-0bb0fd) puts the new tenant's role claim in them. Picking a site the person has no active membership of is refused before writing. Touches: lib/prospectus-tenant.ts, lib/tenant-keys.ts, the newsroom switcher in app/newsroom, the CLI's site file tenant (docs/cli-login.md). Acceptance: a Gherkin feature in features_backend covering the switch (Ada switches alpha to beta and her next token carries beta only), the refused pick, and the CLI choice. Testing: unit tests plus Behave against stubbed events; no sandbox (D9). Rollout: ships dark with PPY-0bb0fd; no rule reads the claims until PPY-06ae68. Releasable on its own: yes. DynamoDB index: none. AppSync authorisation: none (TenantSelection owner rule already shipped).
